profiles.title: Qwen3.8-27B on 1 x RTX 3090 24 GB (TP1, with vision, 2 sequences, 4 MP images)

capacity.basis: KV pin = 290 whole blocks of 33,423,360 B (17 attention layers x 960 tokens x 2,048 B). On the 0.32 engine (Merlin 3.0.0) this pin gave 271,506 tokens (2026-10-21): one 262K session or two 131K sessions resident. Measured at this row's release check (2026-10-21).

profiles.p2p: Not needed (one card).
evidence: Single-card recipe qualified as 27B v1.1.0 on the reference host at a 1,048,576-pixel image cap (KV pin 290 blocks), then parked; re-expressed as models/qwen38-27b/serve-1card.sh.

2026-10-21, 0.32 engine, KV pin 9,692,774,400 B (pool 271,506 tokens: one 262K or two 131K sessions): without the single-card settings the card runs out of memory at 3 MP (27 MiB free). With them, 4 MP passes at one and two sequences and after a 262K needle with 563 MiB (a second 3090 host) / 558 MiB (reference host) minimum free, sampled every 100 ms (bar 524 MiB), 6 of 6 rounds; text identity vs the base launch, seeded-image identity and the 262K needle OK; GSM8K-200 194/200. 8 MP stays short (483 / 478 MiB).
The in-place vision rotary is bit-identical to the copying path on an RTX 3090 (production geometry, 6 of 6 cases).
notes: Vision tower weights live in host RAM (--cpu-offload-gb 1 --cpu-offload-params visual); one image per prompt, capped at 4,194,304 pixels (4 MP; MAX_PIXELS) with VLLM_MERLIN_VISION_PEAK=1. One card keeps the 262K KV pin and takes 4 MP, not the 8 MP of the multi-card layouts.

Single-card image headroom, all on by default and output-identical: a 96 MiB FlashInfer workspace (VLLM_FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BUFFER_SIZE=100663296), the MTP drafter sharing it (MERLIN_SHARE_DRAFT_WORKSPACE=1) and the vision rotary applied in place in the QKV buffer (VLLM_MERLIN_VISION_ROTARY_INPLACE=1); each env variable overrides.

Run headless on the card. 4 MP measured with these settings (a second 3090 host and the reference host, 2026-10-21): 563 / 558 MiB minimum free at one and two sequences and after a 262K needle (bar 524), identity and the 262K needle OK, GSM8K-200 194/200. 8 MP stays short (483 / 478 MiB) and the pool is never cut to make it fit.
MTP K=4 (fixed), RecoverSSM on (--use-replayssm), prefix caching + retention on.

profiles.title: Qwen3.8-27B on 2 x RTX 3090 24 GB (TP2)

capacity.basis: Launcher header (883 whole blocks per card): three 262K or six 131K sessions resident, at K=4.

Images are capped at 8,388,608 pixels (8 MP) by default (MAX_PIXELS).

profiles.title: Qwen3.8-27B on 2 x RTX 3090 24 GB without P2P (TP2)

launcher.note: no shim pins this row; merlin serve 27b <dir> --tp 2 on a host without P2P (or --profile 27b-tp2-3090-nop2p) starts it

capacity.basis: Same layout and per-card KV pin as 27b-tp2-3090, so the pool is that row's by construction: P2P changes how the cards talk, not the KV pool. Not measured on RTX 3090s without P2P.

evidence: None on RTX 3090s without P2P on this release. notes: Pins and sequence caps are the K=4 figures.

profiles.title: Qwen3.8-27B on 4 x RTX 3090 24 GB (TP4)

kv_tier_seqs.basis: Experimental, merlin serve --swarm: 32 sequences with the KV RAM cache at >= 12 GiB per rank (48g on four ranks), the size qualified on the reference host (27B TP4 with P2P: 32 agents, 253 turns, 0 errors, aggregate 187 tok/s, TTFT p50 16.2 s / p99 77.9 s, no preemption; 48 agents collapsed).
